note: Officeholders and districts for the four Mount Washington Valley towns (Conway, Bartlett, Jackson and Madison) as listed by NH RSA 662 (districts), Citizens Count, the NH General Court, the NH Executive Council, Ballotpedia, the Conway Daily Sun, Carroll County and The Ballot Brief, checked Oct 30 to 31, 2026. North Conway is a village in the Town of Conway. All four towns share the same U.S. House, Executive Council and State Senate districts; they differ in State House district and, for Madison, county commissioner district. Positions are the officials' own survey answers or quoted statements, with the year. Nothing here is characterized or scored.
ballot_note: Governor, U.S. Senate, U.S. House (NH-1), Executive Council District 1, State Senate District 3 and the county sheriff, attorney, treasurer, register of deeds and register of probate are on every valley ballot on Tuesday, Nov 3, 2026. State House: Conway votes for Carroll 1 (3 seats); Bartlett and Jackson for Carroll 2 (2 seats); Madison for Carroll 3 (2 seats) and the Carroll 8 floterial (2 seats). County commissioner: Conway, Bartlett and Jackson vote in District 1; Madison in District 2. Polls are open 8am to 7pm: Conway at the Town Garage, 1611 East Main St., Center Conway; Bartlett at Josiah Bartlett Elementary School, 1313 US Route 302; Jackson at the Whitney Community Center, 16 Black Mountain Rd.; Madison at Madison Elementary School, 2069 Village Rd. Results will replace the names below.

levels.title: Federal
levels.blurb: Two senators and one representative. All of Carroll County, including Conway, Bartlett, Jackson and Madison, is in New Hampshire's 1st Congressional District (RSA 662:1).

levels.title: State
levels.blurb: The Governor, your Executive Councilor and your State Senator. All four valley towns are in Executive Council District 1 and State Senate District 3 (RSA 662:2 and 662:3).

levels.title: State House
levels.blurb: Each town's State House seats (RSA 662:5). Conway is its own three-seat district, Carroll 1. Bartlett and Jackson share Carroll 2 (two seats) with Albany, Chatham, Hale's Location, Hart's Location and Sandwich. Madison is in Carroll 3 (two seats, with Moultonborough and Tamworth) and also in the Carroll 8 floterial district (two seats, with Brookfield, Eaton, Effingham, Freedom, Moultonborough, Tamworth and Wakefield), so Madison voters elect four House members. No floterial district includes Conway, Bartlett or Jackson. Every seat is on the Nov 3 ballot.

levels.title: Carroll County
levels.blurb: The three county commissioners are the county's executive board, in charge of the county budget, nursing home, jail and staff; the sheriff, county attorney, treasurer and registries also sit under the county. Conway, Bartlett and Jackson are in Commissioner District 1 (with Albany, Chatham, Hart's Location, Sandwich and Hale's Location); Madison is in District 2 (with Moultonborough, Ossipee, Tamworth and Tuftonboro). No valley town is in District 3. Every county office is on the Nov 3 ballot.

openQuestions.text: Citizens Count's Jackson page shows Jackson in the 2nd Congressional District. New Hampshire law (RSA 662:1) puts all of Carroll County, including Jackson, in the 1st District, and the Bartlett and Madison pages agree, so Agorri shows Jackson in District 1. Check your sample ballot to be sure.
